cookies.skill: Lotus Root Phantom Cookie used to spend the time leisurely by a small lake in the desert. She would put her trickster mind to use by playing all kinds of pranks on unassuming Cookies that had gotten lost in the desert. WhenPine Monk Cookie'sparty managed to avoid falling for her traps, she took a keen interest and joined them on their journey.Though she rarely reveals her true feelings, she seems quite content among this group of unique and talented personalities.

cookies.skill: Hard as granite and swift as the wind, Kaymak Cookie knows not a fear in the world. He is known for his arrogant nature, fearing not even the heavens, but upon closer inspection, he possesses a nature as pure and profound as milk.After spending 500 years isolated in the mountains due to his uncontrollable power, he was able to return to the world and embark on a path of asceticism under the guidance of acertain Cookie. Through indefatigable training, he has learned to wield his power beneficially and is being reformed into a Cookie with an increasingly deep and solid flavor.

Her biggest strengths are her fiery temperament that causes her to charge straight into any problem, and her hearty nature that allows her to shake off any hardship and bounce right back at the sight of a delicious meal.

cookies.skill: Blooming Dancheong Cookie was baked from gat-kimchi, made by grinding plum blossoms that bloomed in the snow and seasoning them over mustard leaves. Born from ingredients that overcame biting winds and solitude, this Cookie came to possess a spirit both resilient and noble. To create a land where Cookies could thrive, Blooming Dancheong Cookie gathered the energy of the Five Colors, swept away the heavy clouds, and planted a colossal plum World Tree on Mount Kimchi, the peak closest to the sky, linking heaven and earth as one. Warm sunlight and the gentle fragrance of plum blossoms soon began to fill the barren land. A world that had once been silent slowly became alive with the laughter of Cookies, and Blooming Dancheong Cookie, accompanied by the Plum Blossom Dragons, continued to watch over them. Though the tale now lives on only as a legend, a lone shrine is said to still be standing at the summit of Mount Kimchi, where Blooming Dancheong Cookie is worshipped as a mountain spirit.
